title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Matthew 1: the genealogy of Jesus Christ, Joseph's dream, and the names Jesus and Immanuel.

questions.text: Verse 1 calls Jesus Christ the son of which two men?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:1 is the book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

questions.text: By whom did Judah become the father of Perez and Zerah?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:3 says Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar.

questions.text: By whom did Boaz become the father of Obed?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:5 says Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth.

answers.text: Her who had been Uriah's wife

questions.text: Whom does verse 6 name as the son of Jesse?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:6 says Jesse became the father of King David, and David became the father of Solomon.

questions.text: At what time does verse 11 say Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:11 says Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

answers.text: At the building of the temple
During a famine in the land
At the time of the exile to Babylon
In the days of the judges

questions.explanation: Matthew 1:16 says Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

questions.text: How many generations does verse 17 count from Abraham to David?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:17 says all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations.

questions.text: What did Joseph intend to do when Mary was found pregnant?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:19 says Joseph, being a righteous man and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

answers.text: Wait until the child was born

questions.text: What reason did the angel give for the name Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:21 says: You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.

answers.text: Because he will save his people from their sins
Because he will reign over all the nations
Because his mother chose that name
Because he will gather Israel from exile

questions.text: What does the chapter say the name Immanuel means?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:23 says they shall call his name Immanuel, which is, being interpreted, God with us.
